meta.description: Write code that calls the installed nvMolKit Python API for GPU-accelerated, batched RDKit-style operations - Morgan fingerprints, Tanimoto/cosine similarity, ETKDG conformer embedding, MMFF/UFF optimization, TFD, conformer RMSD, Butina clustering, and substructure search. Use when importing nvmolkit.*, debugging an nvmolkit call, choosing between nvMolKit and RDKit for batched cheminformatics workflows.

recommendations.title: Add filtering pattern for MMFF atom type errors
recommendations.problem: ValueError args[1] dict structure documented but no example showing how to use indices to filter invalid molecules before retry
recommendations.root_cause: Error structure documented without recovery workflow
recommendations.fix: Add to MMFF recipe after ValueError documentation: 'Recovery pattern: try: MMFFOptimizeMoleculesConfs(mols); except ValueError as e: invalid = e.args[1]; bad_idx = set(invalid.get("none", [])) | set(invalid.get("no_params", [])); valid_mols = [m for i, m in enumerate(mols) if i not in bad_idx]; MMFFOptimizeMoleculesConfs(valid_mols)'

recommendations.title: Add GPU OOM handling guidance
recommendations.problem: No guidance on handling GPU out-of-memory during large batch operations (thousands to millions of molecules)
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes users will tune batch sizes via HardwareOptions; failure scenario not addressed
recommendations.fix: Add troubleshooting section after Going deeper: 'GPU OOM errors → reduce batch size via HardwareOptions(batchSize=...) or split input into chunks. For similarity matrices too large for GPU, use crossTanimotoSimilarityMemoryConstrained (chunked compute, CPU output). Alternatively, use nvmolkit.autotune.tune_* functions to find optimal batch size for your hardware.'

recommendations.title: Add install verification failure recovery
recommendations.problem: Smoke test shows success path but not specific recovery steps if test fails (which package to uninstall, which reinstall order)
recommendations.root_cause: Delegates to docs for all failures rather than showing one common fix inline
recommendations.fix: Add after smoke test: 'If import fails or cuda unavailable=True: (1) pip uninstall nvmolkit torch; (2) reinstall torch for CUDA 12.x from pytorch.org; (3) pip install nvmolkit. If still failing, see docs install guide for driver/toolkit version diagnosis.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for deterministic operations
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether batched operations produce identical results across runs
recommendations.root_cause: Determinism assumed for fingerprints/RMSD but not stated; ETKDG stochasticity not consolidated
recommendations.fix: Add to Result types section: 'Determinism: fingerprints, similarity, RMSD, TFD are deterministic (same inputs → same outputs). ETKDG with useRandomCoords=True is stochastic unless RNG seed is fixed. MMFF/UFF minimization is deterministic given same starting conformers.'
